summary: moveTask clears endedByArchiving when a RecurringTask is moved to a non-archived Project

ops.spec: Reassigns a Task from its current Project to a different Project. If the Task is a RecurringTask whose endedByArchiving is true, moveTask sets endedByArchiving to false, since the archiving that caused it no longer applies once the Task belongs to a different Project, while leaving its ended state unchanged. This applies when the destination Project is not archived; what moveTask does when the destination Project is itself archived is not yet specified.

tests: Moving a RecurringTask whose endedByArchiving is true into a non-archived Project sets endedByArchiving to false.
Moving such a RecurringTask does not change its ended value: if it was ended, it stays ended, just no longer attributed to archiving.
A RecurringTask moved this way is not resumed by a later unarchiveProject of the Project it was moved out of, since endedByArchiving is no longer true.
A RecurringTask whose endedByArchiving is already false is unaffected by this rule when moved.
